name: field-service-cloud-workflows
description: Review crews and jobsites, prepare Operations Briefs, and create operations reviews, monthly client reports and customer estimate proposals from Field Service Cloud records.

interface.longDescription: Review your crews and jobsites, see work that needs attention, and prepare operations reviews, monthly client reports or customer estimate proposals from Field Service Cloud records. In Workspace, choose report content or select an Extra and a standard or attached proposal template, then request Word, PDF or both. Translate a saved note while retaining the original. Connect with your own Field Service Cloud account. Workspace and file options depend on what your assistant supports.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open the Field Service Cloud workspace.
